title: Post-DeepSeek audit, repair and Luna build loops
start_conditions: User reports DeepSeek stopped at usage limit; interrupted M1-03 checkpoint has been audited and preserved.
Coordinator records final Git commit or exact diff and independently audits implementation and evidence.
Luna repair scope is derived from that audit; no overlapping implementation writer.

scope: Ancestry-anchor qualification, chain/config binding, consecutive heights, deep-fork invalidation and restart recovery.
Durable capture, quiet blocks, failure checkpoints, receipt attribution, immutable causal snapshots and exact export round trip.
Real-data terminal UI interactions, stale/error states, evidence, injection resistance and fresh-process/browser behavior.
Coverage evidence and elapsed-time gates; no self-certified recall or silently skipped integration acceptance.
Changes outside the intended batch, regressions, dependency/security implications and discrepancies between code and reported completion.

goals.done_when: Every release-blocking finding is fixed and independently rechecked; any deferred finding has an explicit affected-capability gate. A passing suite alone is insufficient.

goals.goal: Run an actual connectome model and reproducible local training
goals.done_when: Verified biological graph drives reproducible trained predictions and matched controls; held-out report and measured PC resource requirements exist. Reuse B2 data work as its dependency requires.

goals.goal: Observe wallets and learn continuously without user trades
goals.done_when: Durable observation, mature labels, automatic candidate training/evaluation and restart recovery work during a zero-personal-trade interval, with honest wait/outage states.

goals.goal: Deliver entry, LP and exit signals with manual feedback
goals.done_when: Versioned brain proposals, supported position accounting, manual transaction linkage and outcome feedback integrate; research-only versus qualified spot/LP status is explicit.

goals.goal: Evaluate, version and accept the brain product
goals.done_when: Forward evaluation, controlled promotion/rollback, Windows/WSL2 packaging and a reproducible manual-execution feedback demonstration meet acceptance.

Reconcile all 26 next-build tasks and 77 original tasks against actual evidence, completing remaining in-scope engineering and real observation gates. Unsupported/conditional/external items stay explicitly open or conditional; no new signing scope is inferred.

loop: Select a concrete dependency-ready slice from the B and mapped M tasks; bring biological experiments forward.
Declare objective, target files, acceptance evidence and applicable gates.
Implement or repair the slice while preserving others work.
Run focused meaningful checks and required integration/browser tests; investigate failures.
Update JSON/evidence/logs and validate planning; preserve independent review boundaries.
Checkpoint verified changes and push to the existing private repo under standing authorization, excluding unrelated work and secrets; record CI separately.
Continue the next ready slice without a routine permission prompt; checkpoint genuine external blockers and continue independent work.
rules: Goal groups overlap intentionally; task dependencies determine execution order.
No automatic extra agents/tasks or model changes.
No model promotion from training completion alone; no fabricated time, data, test results, profitability or biological advantage.
No automatic trading, signing, funding, paid subscriptions or source-access bypass in this version.
Timed gates require actual evidence and appropriate running infrastructure; software completion is not measured acceptance.
If usage/session limits interrupt a loop, leave a precise resumable checkpoint; do not imply background continuation has been scheduled.

verification: replacement-tip, no-op revalidation, outage and requalification fixtures
same-checkpoint replacement-log replay, partial cursor and replay-failure fixtures
strict nested evidence and endpoint credential-canary fixtures

coordinator_acceptance.evidence: 150 sandbox-passing tests plus two permitted loopback integration tests; planning, compile, reproduction and diff checks pass
deferred_gates: live canonical source and archive evidence

operator_evidence.market_feedback_corpus: market-feedback-build consumes only the resolved canonical raw projection, decodes standard-hook V4 Initialize/Swap evidence into exact integer price points, derives availability-aware no-wallet features, emits observed/censored/unresolved forward outcomes with chronological partitions, and returns waiting with canonical_checkpoint=null on a fresh unresolved store; feedback-import accepts the resulting bundle
operator_evidence.watcher_callback_recovery: LearningWatcher.run_pending_tasks requeues interrupted running tasks with interrupted_process_recovery, claims supplied callbacks one at a time, preserves tasks with no callback, and records completed/waiting/callback_failed outcomes without widening execution scope
operator_evidence.watcher_cli: watcher-tick and watcher-status recorded two zero-personal-trade ticks in a fresh SQLite state; the first reported waiting/no_mature_labels and the 60-second gap reported degraded/outage_since_previous_tick; changed config hashes fail closed
operator_evidence.watcher_scheduler: watcher-tick --schedule durably enqueues one due task for observation, labels, training and evaluation, persists scheduling slots across restart, coalesces still-pending work without a personal-trade trigger, and exposes the slots through watcher-status
operator_evidence.signal_surface: serve --check loaded a versioned empty signal snapshot with research-only readiness and a waiting training state; the dashboard/API remains display-only and shows no signals when no bundle is supplied
operator_evidence.manual_action_surface: the same typed signal bundle loader parsed one manual action and one wallet activity and produced an exact transaction link for fresh-process /actions data
operator_evidence.manual_status_projection: fresh-process /actions and /signals both returned matched for the linked action, and the dashboard rendered the manual-status column
operator_evidence.feedback_runtime: feedback-import inserted one typed observed-market prediction/outcome and matured one eligible example at the declared cutoff; feedback-status remains durable and idempotent
operator_evidence.feedback_training_runtime: train_malecns_feedback.py consumed an empty durable feedback store and returned waiting with no graph load/training and three declared seeds; the report records manifest, feature-map, partition-map hashes, fixed experiment configuration and max-example budget, while invalid partitions and oversized runs fail/stop before graph load; --corpus also consumes a market-feedback bundle's causal labels/maps and records its corpus hash
operator_evidence.wallet_runtime: wallet-import and wallet-status imported one typed confirmed swap and projected one healthy public-wallet activity at explicit event/arrival cutoffs with no position
operator_evidence.signal_generation_runtime: signal-build wrote one versioned prediction/proposal snapshot from explicit model output, preserving unavailable confidence and research-only/manual-only gates; the server loader consumed it
operator_evidence.model_output_bridge: model-output selects one serialized connectome experiment metric, preserves graph/run/report-hash lineage, carries validation/test partitions and excludes final-test rows from typed signal output; waiting experiments emit no predictions and action mappings remain explicit
operator_evidence.model_evaluation_cli: model-evaluate recorded a controlled paired candidate/active report while model-status confirmed the active version was unchanged and one final-test identity was consumed
operator_evidence.model_control_cli: model-promote applied a qualified serialized evaluation to the local registry and model-rollback restored a recorded version with history; no model-control command touches signing, funding or transaction execution
operator_evidence.model_registry_surface: an existing model registry can be attached read-only to serve, exposed at /models and the dashboard with active-version/history state; missing registry or initial version fails closed
operator_evidence.runtime_smoke_2026_09_14: operator-check returned ready with 16/16 fixture checks, a fresh watcher schedule tick returned waiting/no_mature_labels with zero personal trades and four due tasks, restart status restored four slots, and repository shadow correctly returned blocked because config is not frozen
operator_evidence.feedback_training_bridge: build_training_samples_from_feedback converts one eligible causal label with explicit test partition and reports missing features as an exclusion

last_verified_state: G0 accepted by coordinator on 2026-09-14; B0-B10 mechanics and fixture checks pass with research_release_only status. One bounded live-readonly capture at block 61693479 acknowledged an empty range with one persisted header and no events; ancestry remained unavailable, so no completeness claim is made. The actual MaleCNS artifact subset recheck passed at 20,000 edges and drove a three-step reservoir smoke run; deterministic four-way partition loading, 100,000-edge resource benchmarks and a 100,000-edge controlled five-model training/control run now have measured host evidence, while real-label training and holdout acceptance remain open. The wide-state readout now uses a dual ridge system and graph validation scales with node sets; the random-weight control preserves mean scale and remains distinct on constant-weight partitions. The local dashboard/API smoke check returns read-only health/signals/dashboard responses and rejects POST with 405. M4-03 keeps optional adapters unavailable until supported access is verified; M4-04 now bounds callbacks and persists cumulative LLM budgets; M4-05 now checks complete same-identity hybrid factorial cells before attribution. M5-01 now has exact Q96 amount math, modular fee growth, owned idempotent lifecycle checks and denomination-aware gas debit/liability accounting; M5-02 now keeps LP out of shared-capital metrics until verified evidence, and M5-03 records the current inconclusive research decision. LP remains disabled. M2/M3 live, timed and economic gates and M4/M5 evidence acceptance remain open; no routine coordinator pause is required.
